caseNameFull: Shieh v. Hathaway Shieh v. Ebershoff

opinions.text:
C. A. 9th Cir.; and

C. A. 9th Cir. Motions of petitioner for leave to proceed in forma pauperis denied. See this Court’s Rule 39.8. Petitioner is allowed until May 6, 1996, within which to pay the docketing fees required by Rule 38(a) and to submit petitions in compliance with Rule 33.1 of the Rules of this Court.
